ModMetaData.name: Connor's Sidearms!
ModMetaData.author: Kaan Connor Barmore-Genc
ModMetaData.description:
Pawns can carry spare weapons in their inventory and swap to them.
Draft a pawn and a gizmo appears for each sidearm they carry; click it to swap. Right-click a weapon on the ground to pick it up as a sidearm.
Pawns automatically draw a melee weapon when an enemy closes to melee range, and put it away again when the fight goes back to range. Optionally they also swap to a longer-ranged weapon when the enemy is too far for the one they are holding.
Sidearms live in the pawn's normal inventory, so they weigh something, they show up in the gear tab, and they drop on death.
